title: RuntimeError: PytorchStreamReader failed
body:
My company's IT team installed boltz-1 on our HPC system and I tried running it to predict a 2 chain protein multimer complex structure. I am getting the error shown below. I am sure the fasta files have the correct format and the msa folders are being created too. Any help with this error is much appreciated.
Thanks

author: varunmc92

comments.body: I think this is likely a failed / partial download of the model weights. Try deleting the checkpoint located in the cache folder (`~/.boltz/` by default) and running the command again, it will launch download again and hopefully be fine this time around!
Thanks for the reply. I will let you know soon if it worked.

satisfaction_conditions: A solution that resolves the 'PytorchStreamReader failed' error when running boltz-1
Instructions for handling corrupted or incomplete model weight files
A straightforward troubleshooting approach that can be implemented by the user

_classification.category: Requires build environment but hard to be dockerized
